responsibilities: Data modelling & architecture: Build & create data models that help solve business problems. Follow team conventions and best practices for data architecture design. Understand Git workflows and raise PRs for review.

Semantic Layer & BI development: Define, build and edit semantic layer views that power customer-facing analytics such as User Apps, Dashboards, and AI tools. Create and build scalable and reusable dashboards.
Engineering collaboration & deployment: Understand the essentials of how analytics are surfaced within products. Participate in cross-team meetings and follow agreed deployment processes.

Commercial & stakeholder partnership: Understand the core commercial metrics and KPIs of the business. Respond to data requests from commercial teams. Build awareness of how data outputs are used in decision-making.

Team enablement & technical leadership: Seek support from senior colleagues, be curious and ask challenging questions. Share learnings with data peers. Follows established team processes and documentation standards.

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: You will apply software engineering best practices—like version control, testing, and continuous integration—to the world of data warehousing.
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: The role is defined by "software engineering best practices—like version control, testing, and continuous integration", with speed language confined to the company blurb.
evidence.domain_risk: You are building scalable data models that enable our platform to deliver real-time insights to the world’s largest transport operators.
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Output drives operator decisions on a B2B SaaS platform with no regulatory or financial-reporting language, so it sits at moderate.
evidence.data_team_maturity: You will play a critical role in scaling our Modern Data Information Layer.
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: A Data Analytics team, senior colleagues and "established team processes and documentation standards" already exist, and the job is scaling that layer.
evidence.jd_authorship: Understand Git workflows and raise PRs for review.
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Some bullets name real mechanics like "Git workflows and raise PRs for review", while others are competency-framework phrasing such as "be curious and ask challenging questions".
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Respond to data requests from commercial teams.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: Weight is split evenly between "data requests from commercial teams" and semantic layer views that "power customer-facing analytics" in the product.
evidence.autonomy_level: Follows established team processes and documentation standards.
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role works inside set conventions — "follow agreed deployment processes" and "Seek support from senior colleagues" — so delivery is scoped, not direction-setting.
evidence.ai_role: Define, build and edit semantic layer views that power customer-facing analytics such as User Apps, Dashboards, and AI tools.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: The candidate builds the semantic layer that "AI tools" consume, so AI sits downstream of their output.
evidence.testing_framing: You will apply software engineering best practices—like version control, testing, and continuous integration—to the world of data warehousing.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Testing is framed as practice the candidate applies, not a tool sitting in a skills list.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: your mission is to ensure that every data user at CitySwift is working from a single, high-quality source of truth
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: The role summary's opening line is about trust in the numbers, so the fear is data users working from conflicting or wrong figures.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Build & create data models that help solve business problems.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: New models get built, but inside an existing layer the role is "scaling", so both signals carry weight.
evidence.work_arrangement: Flexible working with hybrid working as the default in Ireland, core hours of 10am to 4pm, remote options depending on role and a work abroad programme of up to 6 weeks.
evidence.loss_aversion: "As an Analytics Engineer, your mission is to ensure that every data user at CitySwift is working from a single, high-quality source of truth." Trust in a single source of truth opens the role description.
